actions.script:
receiptJson = null
if (lastCompletedId && completedTxn) {
// Load receipt template for store details
def rTpl = (terminal?.organizationPartyId ? ec.entity.find("zenith.erp.pos.PosReceiptTemplate").condition("organizationPartyId", terminal.organizationPartyId).condition("isActive", "Y").orderBy("-isDefault").limit(1).one() : null)
// Operator/cashier name
def operatorName = ''
if (session?.operatorPartyId) {
def opPerson = ec.entity.find("mantle.party.Person")
.condition("partyId", session.operatorPartyId).one()
if (opPerson) operatorName = [(opPerson.firstName ?: ''), (opPerson.lastName ?: '')].findAll{it}.join(' ')
}
// Build store info from template or terminal
def storeAddr = ''
def storePhone = ''
def headerTxt = ''
def footerTxt = ''
def termsTxt = ''
if (rTpl) {
storeAddr = [rTpl.addressLine1, rTpl.addressLine2, rTpl.city, rTpl.state, rTpl.pincode].findAll{it}.join(', ')
storePhone = rTpl.phone ?: ''
headerTxt = rTpl.headerText ?: ''
footerTxt = rTpl.footerText ?: ''
termsTxt = rTpl.termsText ?: ''
}
// Build items with MRP and savings
def totalSaving = (completedTxn.discountTotal ?: 0) as BigDecimal
def rItems = receiptItems.collect {
def mrp = (it.mrp ?: it.unitPrice ?: 0) as BigDecimal
def rate = (it.unitPrice ?: 0) as BigDecimal
def qty = (it.quantity ?: 0) as BigDecimal
def saving = (it.discountAmount ?: 0) as BigDecimal
if (saving < 0) saving = BigDecimal.ZERO
// The bill discount total already includes explicit line discounts.
[
name: it.productName ?: it.productId,
mrp: zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(mrp, '#,##0')),
qty: zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(qty, '#,##0.##')),
rate: zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(rate, '#,##0.00')),
total: zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(it.lineTotal ?: 0, '#,##0.00')),
saving: zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(saving, '#,##0.00')),
hasSaving: saving > 0,
disc: (it.discountAmount ?: 0) as BigDecimal,
discPct: it.discountPercent ?: 0,
discAmt: zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(it.discountAmount ?: 0, '#,##0.00')), uom: (it.uomId ? (["OTH_ea":'Nos',"WT_g":'g',"WT_kg":'kg',"VLIQ_ml":'ml',"VLIQ_L":'L',"LEN_m":'m',"LEN_cm":'cm'].get(it.uomId) ?: '') : '')
]
}
def rPayments = receiptPayments.collect { [method: it.paymentMethod, amount: zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(it.amount ?: 0, '#,##0.00'))] }
def totalQty = receiptItems.sum { (it.quantity ?: 0) as BigDecimal } ?: 0
def paidTotal = receiptPayments.sum { (it.amount ?: 0) as BigDecimal } ?: 0
def builder = new groovy.json.JsonBuilder([
storeName: rTpl?.companyName ?: terminal?.terminalName ?: 'Store',
storeAddr: storeAddr,
storePhone: storePhone,
storeEmail: rTpl?.email ?: '',
taxReg: rTpl?.taxRegistrationNumber ?: terminal?.taxRegistrationNumber ?: '',
headerText: headerTxt,
footerText: footerTxt,
termsText: termsTxt,
billNo: completedTxn.transactionNumber,
date: ec.l10n.format(completedTxn.entryDate, 'dd/MM/yyyy hh:mm a'),
saleBy: operatorName,
customer: completedTxn.customerName ?: 'Walk-In Customer',
customerPhone: completedTxn.customerPhone ?: '',
customerGstin: completedTxn.customerTaxRegNumber ?: '',
items: rItems,
itemCount: receiptItems.size(),
totalQty: zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(totalQty, '#,##0.##')),
subtotal: zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(completedTxn.subtotal ?: 0, '#,##0.00')),
discount: zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(completedTxn.discountTotal ?: 0, '#,##0.00')),
hasDiscount: ((completedTxn.discountTotal ?: 0) as BigDecimal) > 0,
tax: zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(completedTxn.totalTaxAmount ?: 0, '#,##0.00')),
hasTax: ((completedTxn.totalTaxAmount ?: 0) as BigDecimal) > 0,
roundOff: zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(completedTxn.roundOff ?: 0, '#,##0.00')),
hasRoundOff: ((completedTxn.roundOff ?: 0) as BigDecimal) != 0,
total: zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(completedTxn.payableAmount ?: 0, '#,##0.00')),
payments: rPayments,
totalPaid: zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(paidTotal, '#,##0.00')),
change: zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(completedTxn.changeAmount ?: 0, '#,##0.00')),
hasChange: ((completedTxn.changeAmount ?: 0) as BigDecimal) > 0,
totalSaving: zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(totalSaving, '#,##0.00')),
hasSaving: totalSaving > 0,
cs: currSymbol ?: '₹',
isCredit: (completedTxn.isCredit == 'Y'),
outstanding: zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(((completedTxn.payableAmount ?: 0) as BigDecimal) - ((completedTxn.paidAmount ?: 0) as BigDecimal), '#,##0.00'))
])
receiptJson = builder.toString()
}

                /* Responsive product grid */



                @media (min-width: 1200px) { .pos-product-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr) !important; } }



                @media (min-width: 768px) and (max-width: 1199px) { .pos-product-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr) !important; } }

                if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {



                    window.addEventListener('load', function() {



                        // Absolute path: sri.buildUrl('sw.js') can't resolve it (not a registered screen
                        // resource) and returns '#'. The file is served at /apps/zenith/pos/sw.js; that path
                        // is also the SW scope, which covers /apps/zenith/pos/Terminal. The '#' guard stays
                        // as defense in case this is ever reverted to buildUrl.
                        // ?v=N: a fresh Cloudflare cache key. The bare /apps/zenith/pos/sw.js URL was cached
                        // by CF for a YEAR as `immutable` (before the nginx no-cache fix) and some CF edges
                        // still served that stale copy, so browsers non-deterministically installed the old
                        // SW. nginx now serves any sw.js (query ignored in `location =`) as no-store; pinning
                        // a never-cached query key guarantees the current SW. Bump N only to force-jump CF.
                        var __swUrl = '/apps/zenith/pos/sw.js?v=6';
                        if (!__swUrl || __swUrl === '#') { return; }
                        navigator.serviceWorker.register(__swUrl).then(function(reg) {



                            console.log('PWA ServiceWorker registered');



                        }).catch(function(e){ /* registration unavailable - stay offline-disabled */ });



                    });



                }



                



                /* legacy offline stack (pos-db.js) removed - the live engine is window._posOffline in pos-terminal.js (ZE-POS-017 cleanup) */
